last.verdict: Kodak's chemicals business keeps growing and the balance sheet is cleaner, but print profit nearly vanished, so total profit barely rose.

takeaways.label: Print profit collapsed
takeaways.text: Print revenue fell 7% to $165 million and its operational EBITDA (a core profit measure) dropped to $1 million from $8 million. The prior quarter's $8 million print profit did not hold.

takeaways.label: Chemicals carry the company
takeaways.text: Advanced Materials & Chemicals revenue rose 21% to $99 million, with $21 million of operational EBITDA. Growth is slower than last quarter's 40%, but it now earns most of the profit.

takeaways.label: Net income flattered by debt paydown
takeaways.text: Net income rose to $21 million from $13 million mainly because interest expense fell to $3 million from $18 million. Profit from operations fell to $15 million from $19 million.

takeaways.label: Cash rebuilt
takeaways.text: Cash rose $27 million to $317 million in the quarter, with $25 million from operations. Operational EBITDA was $31 million, below last quarter's $36 million. Stock pay jumped to $8 million from $1 million.

history.verdict: Kodak's fourth straight year-over-year improvement, with gross profit up 61% and net income of $17 million, now has less debt behind it.

takeaways.label: Margins jumped
takeaways.text: Gross margin rose to 26% from 19% as higher prices and volume outran pricier silver and aluminum. Operational EBITDA reached $36 million, up from $9 million.

takeaways.label: Chemicals led growth
takeaways.text: Advanced Materials & Chemicals revenue rose 40% to $105 million and its operational EBITDA nearly tripled to $22 million. Print grew 10% and swung to an $8 million profit.

takeaways.label: Debt sharply reduced
takeaways.text: Kodak repaid $101 million of term loans and cut interest expense by $9 million. Management said total debt to EBITDA is 1x, versus 23x a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Cash and pension caveats
takeaways.text: Cash fell $47 million to $290 million as inventory rose $37 million on silver and aluminum. Pension income is expected to stay below last year's level through 2026.
